core.headline: Two-bedroom mid-terrace house in Sheerness
core.summary: For sale by Modern Method of Auction. A two-bedroom mid-terrace house in Sheerness requiring modernisation, with no onward chain. Freehold, guide price £150,000 plus non-refundable reservation fee of 4.2%.
core.listing:
For sale by Modern Method of Auction. A two-bedroom mid-terrace house in Sheerness requiring modernisation, offered with no onward chain.

The ground floor provides a reception room. The first floor has two bedrooms and a bathroom. The property benefits from gas central heating.

Outside, there is a rear yard. On-street parking is available without a permit.

Station Terrace is located in Sheerness.

Guide Price £150,000. This property is sold by Modern Method of Auction with a 56-day reservation period. The guide price indicates the seller's minimum expectation; the reserve will be within 10% of the guide. A non-refundable reservation fee of 4.2% of the purchase price (minimum £6,000) including VAT is payable by the buyer in addition to the purchase price. Freehold. Council Tax Band A (Swale Borough Council). EPC rating E. Offered with no onward chain. Construction: standard. Electricity: mains. Water: mains (metered). Sewerage: mains. Heating: gas central heating. Broadband: FTTC. Mobile signal: good outdoor coverage on major networks. Parking: on-street, no permit required. Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield or mining: none known.
keyFeatures: For sale by Modern Method of Auction
